# Glass, glow and spectral

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/pick.py --write-docs references` from assets/library/techniques.json. Edit the JSON, then regenerate. -->

Frost, refraction, bloom anatomy, rim light, prism and foil colour: light as a device, one dominant accent, every gradient baked and dithered. 14 entries, by category and role. The [index](../technique-library.md) lists every family and each category's house rule.

### Specular sweep

`cl-specular-sweep` · colour and light · workhorse · energy calm · launch, sting, feature, loop

A soft bright band glides once across a settled number, word or logo face, so the element looks locked and made of a real material without moving.

- **Build:** Duplicate the settled text or mark and fill the duplicate with linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0, C.white at 35% alpha 50%, transparent 100%). Make the band about 40% of the text height wide (about 30% of the width for a logo glyph, with peak opacity up to 0.9), clip it to the glyphs with background-clip: text or an SVG mask, and use mix-blend-mode: screen on dark stages. Drive the band's x from -20% to 120% of the element width on E.smooth, so its speed peaks mid-sweep, starting 6-10 f after the element lands. For a looping working state, use a light-grey label with a 120 px lighter band whose background-position is (frame % 60) / 60 on E.linear, and stop it on the frame the state resolves. Keep the sheen inside the glyphs, with no blur or halo outside them.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Exposure.LightSweep`
- **Timing:** A one-shot sweep takes 36 f on E.smooth (about 16 px/f mid-sweep, peaking near 26 px/f). A logo glint brightens over 9 f, holds about 11 f and is clear by 36 f. The loop has a 60 f period on E.linear and is held for up to about 74 f before the result.
- **Use when:** A final number, price or logo that has landed and must hold attention through a still beat, or loading and generating labels.
- **Avoid when:** The element is still moving, or you would need more than one sweep in the shot (it turns into decoration).

### A tile lights from beneath and spills onto its neighbours

`dv-under-light-spill` · colour and light · accent · energy medium · launch, feature

When a key or tile lights, the light is not contained in it: a deep accent glow fills the tile and a white-hot spot sits on one edge, washing over the gap and half the next tile as if a light were under the keyboard; the dark tiles round it pick it up.

- **Build:** Recipe: a baked radial plate (white core, accent body) scaled by transform in screen blend at the tile's edge. Anatomy: Tile near-black, radius 24 px, 1 px top inner highlight; light: a near-white core (r about 60 px) at the tile's edge, an accent body (r about 220 px), falloff to transparent; a floor glow along the bottom third; it grows about 2.5x over 14 f. Sound: VO. Materials: Glow anatomy: core, body and falloff, three stops, never a uniform halo; the core sits off-centre on the edge nearest the next tile.
- **Materials:** Glow anatomy: core, body and falloff, three stops, never a uniform halo; the core sits off-centre on the edge nearest the next tile.
- **Timing:** Bloom 14 f, then holds with the camera move.
- **Use when:** Keyboard, grid and tile UIs on dark grounds; choosing one option.
- **Avoid when:** Light grounds.

### A window floats inside radial light streaks

`dv-radial-light-streaks` · colour and light · accent · energy medium · launch

The final product window floats on black with a thin coloured rim light, and around it broad light streaks radiate from the frame centre (a warm one, a white one, a cool one, a deep one) separated by black gaps, bending past the corners like light leaking round the window.

- **Build:** Recipe: a conic gradient of hard colour stops and black gaps baked as a dithered PNG, blurred once, radially masked and scaled by transform; the rim is a box-shadow. Anatomy: Rim 1.5 px plus a 4 px blur at about 60 % in a tint of the accent; streaks 200-400 px long, blurred 20-40 px, radial from the centre, hidden behind the window by a radial mask (transparent to 70 % of the closest side); drift outward about 1.5 px/f while the window pulls back 6 %. Sound: The last strong kicks. Materials: Conic stops e.g. warm 0-6 %, gap to 10 %, white 18 %, gap 24 %, cool 33 %, gap 40 %, deep 52 %; the window pure white.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Glow.RadialStreaks`
- **Materials:** Conic stops e.g. warm 0-6 %, gap to 10 %, white 18 %, gap 24 %, cool 33 %, gap 40 %, deep 52 %; the window pure white.
- **Conditions:** the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** 30-40 f to the end.
- **Use when:** The last product frame of a dark launch film, after a glass or light act.
- **Avoid when:** Light grounds; the middle of a UI demo.

### Rainbow arcs, prism beams and auras composited into plates

`dv-painted-light-plates` · colour and light · accent · energy calm · launch

Generated or photographic plates carry light painted into them: a full spectral arc over a figure, a broad warm prism beam falling through the body, a soft aura behind the head, a horizontal spectral band across a face, floating double-exposed shapes and a local glow that fades slowly around the feet, all grained together with the plate.

- **Build:** Recipe: SVG and CSS overlays in screen blend over a Photo, plus one grain layer; bake each spectrum as a dithered PNG. Anatomy: Arc: a seven-stop spectrum stroke about 60 px wide, blur 6 px, screen at 0.6. Beam: transparent -> warm at 0.55 -> transparent over about 240 px. Aura: radial, about 260 px. Spectral band: about 20 % of the frame tall, screen at 0.45, blur 12 px. Local glow: radial about 150 px fading 0.8 -> 0.1 over a 240 f hold. Grain about 4 % over everything. Sound: None of its own. Materials: Arc stops outer to inner: red, coral, a thin yellow, a thin green, sky, violet, fading into the sky colour; double exposures at 45 % in lighten.
- **Materials:** Arc stops outer to inner: red, coral, a thin yellow, a thin green, sky, violet, fading into the sky colour; double exposures at 45 % in lighten.
- **Conditions:** the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** Static in the plate; the camera push moves everything together; local glows fade across the hold.
- **Use when:** An imaging or generation brand whose plates are the hero; slow holds.
- **Avoid when:** Product UI; documentary footage.

### Rim streak on card edges

`cl-rim-light-sweep` · colour and light · accent · energy calm · feature, launch, walkthrough

A bright streak travels along a dark card's border while its edges carry a faint lit rim, separating it from a black stage without a drop shadow.

- **Build:** Fill the card with C.ink2 on a C.ink stage and give it a 1 px border of C.white at 8% alpha. Above it, place an SVG rect of the same size and radius with pathLength=1, a 1-2 px stroke of C.accent or C.white, strokeDasharray '0.12 0.88' and strokeDashoffset driven by the frame, so a 120 px segment runs along the top edge or around the whole perimeter. For the whole UI act, breathe the static rim's opacity between 0.6 and 0.8 on sin(2π·frame/180). For a brand that supplies glow, add soft box-shadow halos in a different colour on each of three sides.
- **Ban-safe variant (the default):** Drop the coloured halos entirely. Use one 1 px single-colour border highlight sweeping along the edge, plus a neutral low-opacity drop shadow (0 24px 48px of C.ink at 50%) for lift. The full look relies on glow, gradient, orange; use it only when the brand supplies that look.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Glow.RimLight`
- **Timing:** The streak crosses one edge in 20-30 f on E.linear. The rim breathes ±20% over 180 f and stays on for the whole UI act.
- **Use when:** Flat dark UI cards floating on pure black that need depth and separation without tilting or shadows.
- **Avoid when:** Light-mode UI (use a soft neutral shadow instead), or several cards on screen at once (the streaks compete).

### A fluid swirl of light floods the dark frame and settles

`dv-liquid-light-swirl` · colour and light · signature · energy medium · launch, sting

On an empty dark frame a fluid wave of light rolls in from one corner, a white-hot area followed by curling arms of a pale tint and the accent like ink in water lit from behind, and within half a second it calms into the slow drifting colour field that holds the logo or the line.

- **Build:** Exposure for the light rise plus baked blob plates rotated by transform; the displacement as a static turbulence map at two or three fixed strengths cross-faded, or a pre-rendered swirl clip. Anatomy: Three soft blobs (white, a pale tint, the accent) blurred 80-150 px, rotating about a corner pivot from 60 to 0 deg through a low-frequency displacement (scale 120 -> 0); peak mean luma about 4x the ground; settles into 3-4 drifting blobs. Sound: A whoosh or swell; the line lands after it. Materials: White hotspot, pale tint, accent, deep ground; the hotspot sits in the corner the swirl comes from and is the last thing to fade.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Gradients.GradientField`
- **Materials:** White hotspot, pale tint, accent, deep ground; the hotspot sits in the corner the swirl comes from and is the last thing to fade.
- **Timing:** 30-36 f from dark to the settled field.
- **Use when:** A section opener or the frame before the logo on a dark film.
- **Avoid when:** More than once; light grounds.

### Coloured dots bleed along a border into one spectral ring

`dv-spectral-border-bleed` · colour and light · signature · energy medium · launch, feature

A black pill border carries a few small coloured dots, each matching an integration or a category; colour leaks out of every dot along the border in both directions until the segments meet and the border is one continuous spectral ring, the dots shrinking as they empty, and the ring then turns slowly.

- **Build:** Recipe: per dot a copy of the rounded rect stroked in the dot's colour and masked by a dash (strokeDasharray 2 x spread, strokeDashoffset = position - spread) over a base copy in ink; spread on an in-out. Anatomy: Stroke 3 px, radius 20 px; per dot a gradient segment along the perimeter whose half-length grows from 0 to 25 % of the perimeter on an in-out; outside the segments the stroke stays ink with a soft mix; dots 9 -> 3 px losing 40 % saturation; the ring then rotates about 3 deg/f. Sound: The label swap and the ring's completion on one kick. Materials: Segment ends feather over about 8 % of the perimeter; neighbouring hues meet without a grey seam (order the dots by hue around the shape).
- **Primitive:** `fx/BorderBleed.BorderBleed`
- **Materials:** Segment ends feather over about 8 % of the perimeter; neighbouring hues meet without a grey seam (order the dots by hue around the shape).
- **Conditions:** the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** Leak 12 f, dots absorbed on the next kick (with the label swap), ring turns 60 f.
- **Use when:** Integrations, works-with-everything, a many-source product; one moment.
- **Avoid when:** Single-source products; next to another spectral accent.

### Holographic foil icons with frosted inner tiles

`dv-holographic-icons` · texture and finish · accent · energy calm · launch, feature

Feature or integration icons are rounded squares whose surface swirls with pastel holographic foil (a cool rim, warm, pink and lilac sheen) under a smaller frosted-white tile that carries a plain white glyph; each icon's foil is turned to its own angle, so the grid shimmers as one family.

- **Build:** Recipe: one baked dithered conic foil PNG rotated by transform under a squircle clip, plus the white tile. Anatomy: Base conic gradient (rim hue -> warm -> pink -> lilac -> rim hue) blurred about 6 px inside the shape; inner tile inset 16 %, radius 20 %, white at 75 % with a 1 px white rim; glyph white with a 10 % grey shadow; icon about 80 px at radius 22 %; the foil angle differs per icon. Sound: Small pops on the arrivals. Materials: Example stops teal #2FA39A, peach #F2C1A6, pink #EBA3B9, lilac #C9C3EE; the foil is the film's one spectral accent.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Spectral.Foil`
- **Materials:** Example stops teal #2FA39A, peach #F2C1A6, pink #EBA3B9, lilac #C9C3EE; the foil is the film's one spectral accent.
- **Conditions:** the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** Develop 28 f (saturation pale to full while the focus clears), then hold.
- **Use when:** A grid of features or integrations that must read premium and related; light grounds.
- **Avoid when:** Dark grounds; brand icons that must keep their own colours.

### Radial lens chromatic aberration on light lines

`dv-chromatic-fringe` · texture and finish · accent · energy medium · launch, sting

A red fringe on one side and cyan on the other of silhouettes and caption edges, present on every graphic frame as a fixed offset. Two flavours: a radial lens aberration over the whole graphic layer, so every thin luminous line is three lines (warm toward the frame centre, a green core, blue outside) with a split that grows with distance from the centre; or a lateral split on 3D edges that makes hard lines read as cut glass catching light.

- **Build:** Recipe: two tinted copies offset 2-3 px under the element. Recipe: render the graphic layer three times with mix-blend screen, each keeping one channel (feColorMatrix), scaled 0.982 / 1 / 1.018 about the frame centre (radial) or offset -1 / 0 / +1 px (lateral). Anatomy: Static offset of two tinted copies. Radial: channel scale about 1.8 % of the radius each way (red 0.982, blue 1.018 about the frame centre), so a line at r 450 px carries about 28 px of red-green-blue cross-section plus a wide soft blue glow outside (sigma about 20 px) and a warm haze inside; lines near the centre lose their fringe (a spiral loses it as it tightens). Lateral: 1-1.5 px each side (a warm line one side, cyan the other) round a white core, larger toward the frame edge, with a neutral grey glow. Sound: None. Materials: Static optical property: it animates only because things move through radius. Build it once as a layer over all graphics, never per element.
- **Materials:** Static optical property: it animates only because things move through radius. Build it once as a layer over all graphics, never per element.
- **Conditions:** gradients baked as dithered plates and moved by transform; the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** Static.
- **Use when:** A graphic, glitch-flavoured world.
- **Avoid when:** Clean UI films.

### A word seen through fluted glass, sliced into refracted strips

`dv-fluted-glass-type` · texture and finish · signature · energy medium · launch, sting

The logo or a word sits behind reeded glass: it is broken into vertical bands, each a sideways-shifted, softened slice, so it flickers between sliced and legible while it moves; then the bands clear and the word is sharp.

- **Build:** Recipe: an SVG displacement map driven by a static repeating-gradient stripe image; the strength steps through fixed levels (pre-rendered copies cross-faded). Anatomy: Stripes 40-60 px; per stripe a sawtooth displacement of up to 15-25 px with a lens ramp inside each stripe; edges softened about 4 px; strength 1 -> 0 over 28 f. Sound: A whoosh on the logo's move.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Glass.Glass`
- **Timing:** 28 f.
- **Use when:** A logo or a word reveal on a dark, lit ground; a clarity beat.
- **Avoid when:** Long lines; flat light grounds.

### Frosted glass tiles with rainbow prism rims

`dv-prism-rim-glass-tiles` · depth and 3d · accent · energy calm · launch

Icons orbit inside thick frosted-glass squircles whose edges glow with thin rainbow fringes (one hue on the lit side, its opposite on the other) like light split by a glass edge, while the icon inside stays crisp; out-of-focus tiles become pastel rainbow smudges.

- **Build:** Recipe: a squircle with a padded conic-gradient border masked to the rim, a white frost fill; the conic angle follows the tile's rotation. Anatomy: Tile 140 px, radius 36; frost white at 35 % over a 14 px backdrop blur; a 6-10 px rim of a conic spectrum whose order follows the light direction; bokeh tiles blurred 12-25 px keeping their colours. Sound: None of its own.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Spectral.SpectralRim`, `fx/Glass.Glass`
- **Conditions:** the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** A continuous orbit; the dispersion turns as each tile turns.
- **Use when:** An integrations orbit or icon cloud in a light, airy world.
- **Avoid when:** Dark grounds; flat UI.

### Frosted panel over a living plate

`dv-frosted-panel-over-plate` · depth and 3d · accent · energy calm · launch, feature

A card shows the same moving footage behind it, heavily blurred and slightly brightened, while the plate outside stays sharp; the material the camera dived into becomes the UI's background; an app window floats on warm light; a frosted card rises with a solid offset twin behind it.

- **Build:** RackFocus levels clipped to the card (a fixed blur copy of the plate under the card's mask). Safer than backdrop-filter: render the title twice, a sharp copy clipped outside the card's rect and a blurred, dimmed copy clipped inside it. Anatomy: Backdrop blur about 25 px inside the card; twin offset 45 px right, 60 px down. Sound: A whip whoosh. Materials: Frost construction: where a card overlaps the headline the letters show through as soft dimmed shapes (backdrop blur 8-12 px, letters at 40-50 % luma, no refraction offset), the card's rim stays crisp and its soft shadow darkens the letters just above it; a frosted bar over a halftone sky averages the dots into soft colour because its blur exceeds the dot pitch (blur 24 px, white at 22 %, a 1.5 px bright top edge, an inner shadow at the bottom). The ground behind a composer can be the same glass heavily defocused (blur 60-90 px) with pastel caustic patches and a faint rainbow arc at 8 % for 8 f, drifting against the camera.
- **Primitive:** `fx/RackFocus`
- **Materials:** Frost construction: where a card overlaps the headline the letters show through as soft dimmed shapes (backdrop blur 8-12 px, letters at 40-50 % luma, no refraction offset), the card's rim stays crisp and its soft shadow darkens the letters just above it; a frosted bar over a halftone sky averages the dots into soft colour because its blur exceeds the dot pitch (blur 24 px, white at 22 %, a 1.5 px bright top edge, an inner shadow at the bottom). The ground behind a composer can be the same glass heavily defocused (blur 60-90 px) with pastel caustic patches and a faint rainbow arc at 8 % for 8 f, drifting against the camera.
- **Conditions:** glass as a material with real frost or refraction, not a default card style; the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** Continuous with the plate; rise 30 f expo-out.
- **Use when:** Brands with a glass language.
- **Avoid when:** Frost as a default card style; more than one glass language per film.

### Glass objects refract the world behind them, then turn opaque

`dv-refracting-glass-sphere` · depth and 3d · accent · energy medium · launch, sting

Dark glass spheres fly in, and for their first frames the background shows through them, darkened, magnified and bent (grid lines and a light line displaced inside, a slight colour split on the bright lines); as they land they turn opaque.

- **Build:** Recipe: a clipPath circle holding a scaled, blurred, darkened copy of the backdrop layer, a radial caustic and a rim stroke; the copy's opacity animates. Anatomy: Inside the circle: the backdrop scaled 1.1-1.2x about the sphere's centre, blurred 2-4 px, brightness 0.25, a 2 px channel split on bright lines; a caustic radial gradient from the accent at 80 % to transparent over 30 % of the radius; the refracted copy's opacity 1 -> 0 over the landing. Sound: Bubble pops on the landing, leading the picture by about 30 ms. Materials: Magnification 1.15, blur 3 px, brightness 0.25, caustic in the accent at 0.8.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Glass.Glass`
- **Materials:** Magnification 1.15, blur 3 px, brightness 0.25, caustic in the accent at 0.8.
- **Timing:** Clear 6 f, half 2 f, nearly opaque by 10 f more, overlapping the landing overshoot.
- **Use when:** A 3D or glass act; objects that frame a hero.
- **Avoid when:** Flat UI films.

### Soap-bubble glass with thin-film rainbow bands

`dv-thin-film-dome` · depth and 3d · signature · energy calm · launch

A character or product sits under a clear glass dome that shimmers like a soap bubble: broad concentric pastel rainbow bands follow its curvature, strongest near the rim and fading at the crown, and the world behind is slightly desaturated and bent.

- **Build:** 3D: a hemisphere with a physical material (transmission 1, thickness 0.15, roughness 0.04, iridescence 1, IOR 1.3, film thickness 120-780 nm) under an environment map. 2D: concentric bands baked as a dithered PNG in screen blend inside a circle mask, a white rim, and a backdrop copy scaled 1.03 and desaturated inside. Anatomy: Five band hues (pink, peach, mint, lilac, sky), each 6-10 % of the radius wide, 25-40 % opacity, soft 20 px edges; a white fresnel rim at about 0.6 at grazing angles; the background inside desaturated about 30 % and shifted 2-4 % radially. Sound: An airy pad.
- **Primitive:** `fx/Glass.Glass`
- **Conditions:** the film's one spectral accent
- **Timing:** Present for the shot; the bands drift 1-2 % a second with the camera.
- **Use when:** A hero object that should feel protected, new or magical; airy pastel worlds.
- **Avoid when:** Dark, technical films.
